sourceObservation: The overflow case reused the 30 ms deadline previously assigned to the 10 second sleep control. The product enforces both output and elapsed-time bounds, so the deadline can win before the pipe reader reports overflow.
proposedCorrection: Restore the setup budget of 1000 ms only for the 32-byte overflow case; explicitly restore 30 ms for the inherited-pipe timeout case. All assertion expressions and both 30 ms timeout controls remain. Production code is unchanged.
